Job Objective

职位目标

Work with Relationship Managers to drive new-to-product client acquisition from existing clients and new-to-bank prospects to achieve sales targets, and to defend & grow GTS revenue of key customers via cross-selling/upselling endeavors and best-in-class customer services. GTS uses a consultative selling model, within which GTS Sales and Solutioning manager completes client need analyses and recommendations to effectively engage clients and prospects and thereby provide appropriate cash management and trade finance solutions.

与客户经理团队合作，为现有和潜在客户提供GTS产品方案实现销售目标，同时通过交叉销售和升级销售以及出色的客户服务来使得现有重点客户的GTS收入稳定增长。GTS的企业销售和方案经理会采用顾问式的营销模式，充分了解客户需求以制定推荐方案，并保持与客户的密切沟通，从而提供最合适的现金管理和贸易融资方案。

Principal Responsibilities

主要职责

  • Responsible to drive the cash management and trade finance portfolio to deliver the revenue targets and KPIs to meet the overall GTS business objectives.

负责扩大现金管理和贸易融资的客户群与业务规模以达到预定的收入目标和销售绩效指标从而达成GTS的整体业务目标。

  • Align with respective RMs on the overall account plan and customer segment targets.

与相对应的客户经理积极合作准备账户计划书并共同建立客户目标。

  • Work with the Relationship Managers, GTS Product, GTS Implementation, T&O and relevant stakeholders to deliver the agreed solutions.

与客户经理、产品经理、实施经理、科技与营运部及其他相关部门合作提供客户的解决方案。

  • Work with the relevant stakeholders and product management team to identify market requirements and opportunities and translate opportunities into business requirements.

与相关部门和产品经理合作积极探寻市场的需求和机会所在并且把机会转变为业务需求。

  • For existing key clients, proactively increase DBS’ share of wallet by:
  • Identifying cross-sell opportunities
  • Driving cash balance growth and trade facility utilization
  • Providing advisory support on product updates and market trends
  • Serving as single point of contact to manage GTS related query and service escalations

针对现有重点客户，通过多种方式持续提高星展银行的客户份额，例如：

  • 寻找交叉销售机会
  • 致力于增长存款与贸易额度使用率
  • 提供产品更新与市场动向的顾问支持
  • 作为GTS对客的单一窗口统一协调相关客户咨询与服务

Job Dimensions

职责管辖范畴

  • Develop a sufficient strong pipeline to meet revenue targets, with a wide range of deals covering every stage of the sales cycle.

开发维护一个足够强大的销售管道（即潜在交易列表）来应对利润目标，并对这些交易在不同销售阶段跟进。

  • Accelerate closure of pipeline deals through effective sales techniques to capture revenue quickly.

通过有效的销售策略加快潜在交易转化为成功交易的速度，从而迅速增长利润。

  • Gain the respect and trust of community and network as a professional sales manager to generate referrals and new leads.

在社群和人际网络中建立专业的销售经理形象并且获得尊重和信任，以得到更多的新客户和业务机会的推介。

  • Conduct presentations to internal and external customers. 为内部和外部客户演示产品。
  • Work with other BUs to structure cash or trade solution for customers to achieve greater share of customers’ wallet size. Actively sell GTS products and services to corporate customers in China.

和其他业务部门共同为客户构架现金管理和贸易融资解决方案以获得更大的客户份额，积极为中国的企业客户销售交易服务部的产品和服务。

  • Help establish and maintain communication channels to Relationship Managers for new product launch, product update, promotions, quick tips and success story sharing. These channels include regular product briefing / training sessions, participate in various strategy and review meetings held by various customer segments and regular updates on share points.

协助客户经理建立并保持沟通渠道来推动新产品的推广、更新、促销、快捷指南并分享成功经验。这些渠道包括通常的产品介绍和培训会议、参与针对各个客户群的战略与回顾会议、以及在共享信息平台定期更新信息。

  • For existing key clients, make periodic client calls to deepen engagement, maintain existing trade and cash businesses, source new business opportunities and perform service reviews

针对现有重点客户，进行定期客户拜访来加深关系，维护现有贸易与现金业务，挖掘新的业务机会并进行定期的服务质量回顾

Education And Relevant Experience

教育背景和相关工作经验要求

  • Degree holder or equivalent 本科或以上
  • Excellent command of English (spoken and written) 良好的英语听说读写能力
  • Minimum 7 years’ relevant banking experience 至少7年中国的银行相关经验
  • Strong GTS product knowledge in one or more of the GTS product businesses (cash, open account trade, and trade finance) with a strong track record of sales and business development experience derived from local, cross-border and outbound solutions丰富的GTS产品知识，在销售与市场开发上的良好业绩记录（包括本地、跨境和走出去方案）
  • Demonstrated ability to perform within a matrix organization and regional multi-country franchise 在矩阵组织和覆盖多个国家的区域性公司工作的能力和经验
  • Credit experience/knowledge will be a plus 有信贷方面的经验或知识会是加分项

Functional / Technical Competencies

专业技能要求

  • Ability to influence and impact outcomes 影响力和达成结果的能力
  • Strong team player with good communication and interpersonal skills具有较强的团队合作精神，良好的沟通和人际交往能力
  • Ability to operate in a multi-tasking environment, meet deadlines, and work with a wide range of sensitive and confidential issues能够在多任务环境中工作，按时完成任务，处理各种敏感和机密问题
  • Ability to take initiative, work independently and to accomplish tasks with little supervision能够主动、独立工作，并在很少监督的情况下完成任务
  • Strong strategic mindset with proven analytical skills具有战略思维和经过验证的分析能力
  • Ability to build strong relationships with clients both internal and external能够与内外部客户都建立良好的关系

Location:

PRC - Shanghai

Job:

Product Sales

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

DBS Tech China is hiring a deeply technical, hands-on engineering team lead to drive key wealth management initiatives and investment journeys. This role is suited to a strong full stack engineer who can own a stream end to end, lead one or more engineering squads, and stay close to architecture, design, and implementation.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of modern wealth management platforms and investment journeys within your stream.
  • Act as a hands-on technical leader for one or more engineering squads, driving strong technical execution and engineering standards.
  • Build and evolve full stack systems across a modern stack that includes Java, ReactJS, Python, and Go.
  • Design scalable distributed solutions across microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, and micro-frontend architectures.
  • Own solution design and engineering delivery for your area, ensuring alignment with broader platform and architecture direction.
  • Work closely with product, business, and engineering stakeholders to turn complex requirements into robust technical solutions.
  • Contribute directly to key design decisions, implementation approaches, and critical delivery paths.
  • Evaluate and apply modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted development tooling, where they can improve speed, quality, and developer effectiveness.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience building and delivering large-scale enterprise platforms in a hands-on engineering role.
  • Deep expertise in one or more of these core technologies with strong full stack engineering capability:
  • Browser and Web in Java and ReactJS
  • iOS/Android (Swift/Kotlin)
  • Micro-services and Micro frontend stack
  • E2E architecture of the journeys

Nice to have: Python, Go

  • Proven experience designing scalable, resilient, high-performance systems in customer-facing or transaction-heavy environments.
  • Strong architectural knowledge of distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, and modern micro-frontend patterns.
  • Experience leading a stream or domain area while working closely with one or more engineering squads.
  • Strong experience building order management systems and execution management systems.
  • Strong domain experience in areas such as Bonds, Equities, FX, Structured Products, Funds, Digital Assets, or advisory domains such as portfolio construction, rebalancing, and risk management.
  • Experience in credit or banca domains is a plus.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and business teams.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Location:

Guangzhou (DTC)

Job:

Technology

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Proactively manage a complex portfolio of clients, becoming a trusted advisor to lead strategic dialogues with clients at a portfolio level through the understanding of specific business requirements and delivering creative and flexible customer solutions
  • To hand over customer relationship properly to their relationship managers after closing sales
  • To provide excellent services to customers and ensure all enquiries and complaints are accurately and effectively resolved to customers' satisfaction
  • To participate actively in team building activities to share information/ideas while contributing suggestions for work improvement
  • Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University degree or above (recognized by the state)
  • Strong interpersonal skills and effective presentation skills
  • Well-developed service and sales attitude with ability to work under pressure
  • Presentable, Outgoing and Persuasive
  • Good oral and written English is preferable

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

Position Overview

Details of the Division and Team

Financial and Regulatory Reporting is responsible for the timely and accurate delivery of complete and comprehensive financial and regulatory reporting and analysis, in line with applicable internal policies and external regulatory, statutory and control frameworks. The team will cover:

  • Managing accounting and financial risk and providing advice and guidance on strategic initiatives (driven by internal policies and/or external regulation) and new products that impact the entities /processes /utilities with their remit
  • Collaborating with relevant stakeholders to provide comprehensive financial reporting and analysis
  • Developing innovative business solutions and providing strategic advice and guidance to support the execution of business strategy, mitigation of risks and achievement of the bank’s/regions’/Division’s objectives


What We Will Offer You

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.

You can expect:

  • Supplemental Savings Plan on top of mandatory social security
  • 20 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement
  • A range of competitive benefits to suit your needs
  • On-line family doctor consultation for both employee & family members
  • Employee Assistance Program for both employee & family members


Your Key Responsibilities

This role is to efficiently deliver Regulatory Reporting front to back. Accountable for all aspects of production of Reg Reports from report production to data submission to process efficiency to explain any queries arise internally and externally.

  • Head of Regulatory Reporting (1104), PBOC, SAFE and other reg reporting
  • Collaborate with business and infrastructure partners to deliver values to the bank
  • Deliver results on projects and initiatives through AI/Innovation
  • Has good understanding of regulatory reporting rules
  • Maintain effective relationship with regulators
  • Accountable for Reg Reporting quality, accuracy and timeliness


Your Skills And Experience

  • 15 years+ post qualified experience in a Finance, Control or other Analytical area within a financial institution.
  • Hands-on experiences on local regulatory reporting / dealing with regulators' requests
  • Good working knowledge in managing process and validation
  • Good Chinese and English writing to identifying issues and problem solving
  • Data and Technology experience is a plus
  • Financial control and leadership
  • Project management to lead changes on process, systems, people, solution, sourcing
  • AI Automation & streamline the process
  • Interpreting local regulatory rules and market practices
  • Strategic thinking and realization
  • Business judgment and acumen
  • Team work
  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs


How We’ll Support You

  • Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team
  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
  • Training and development to help you excel in your career


About Us And Our Teams

Deutsche Bank is the leading German bank with strong European roots and a global network. Click here to see what we do.

Deutsche Bank & Diversity

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Job Description

We are seeking a Head of Client Technology, VP to lead the development and delivery of high-impact client-facing technology solutions. This is a senior leadership role that requires a blend of deep technical expertise, strategic vision, and strong team leadership capabilities. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in managing complex technology initiatives, driving digital transformation, and ensuring the security and scalability of mission-critical systems. With a strong focus on innovation and emerging technologies, the candidate will be instrumental in shaping the future of client technology at AMC Tech.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and optimization of client-facing applications, ensuring alignment with business and technical goals.
  • Drive the security of the third-party supply chain, including the evaluation and management of open-source libraries, and conduct regular code scans (e.g., SonarQube, Snyk) to identify and remediate vulnerabilities.
  • Lead or contribute to system architecture integration and upgrades, resolving complex technical challenges and delivering scalable solutions.
  • Develop and maintain modules of self-developed systems, ensuring operational safety, stability, and performance.
  • Oversee the development and project management of key business systems, including sales platforms, CRM, marketing platforms, and product lifecycle management systems.
  • Stay at the forefront of emerging FinTech trends and introduce innovative technologies that enhance business capabilities and client value.
  • Lead the integration and application of AI/ML technologies to enhance client experience, automate processes, and drive data-driven decision-making.
  • Provide strategic leadership to the team, fostering a culture of excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.

Qualifications And Requirements

  • Education: Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 8+ years of software development experience, with at least 5 years in a team leadership or project management role.
  • Industry Experience: Proven experience in asset management application development, including fund sales, marketing systems, CRM, marketing integration platforms, product lifecycle management systems, and e-commerce mobile apps.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficient in the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and security design specifications (e.g., OWASP Top 10).
    • Strong knowledge of the Spring family (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security), distributed architecture, and microservices design.
    • Extensive experience with DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD).
    • Experience in leading large-scale system architecture upgrades or re-engineering projects.
    • Strong background in AI/ML technologies, including experience in deploying AI/ML models, integrating AI into business workflows, and leveraging AI for client-facing applications.
  • Leadership & Team Development: Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor teams, with a track record of talent development and team performance.
  • Soft Skills: Agile mindset, fast learner, excellent communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Additional Preferred Qualifications:
    • Familiarity with AI technologies and experience in AI application development.
    • Fluent in English (written and spoken), with the ability to communicate effectively with global stakeholders.
    • Experience in leading digital transformation initiatives and AI-driven innovation.

As part of JPMorgan Global Research, one of the world's most respected advisory franchises, you'll contribute to fundamental analyses on sectors and companies, and provide actionable ideas and insights. This program is a stepping stone to elevate your career through hands-on experience, skills training, and build a professional network that will lay a strong foundation for your career.

As a Summer Analyst in the Commercial & Investment Bank Research team, you will be part of a dynamic team helping to solve a range of challenging and interesting business issues and will be challenged in your work. The program is an opportunity to take your career to the next level through hands-on experience, relevant skills training and valuable professional networking. Based on your individual achievements, those who successfully complete the program may receive offers of full-time employment.

  • Performing detailed valuation work
  • Assessing relevant news events
  • Analyzing complex data sets
  • Writing research notes, sector pieces, industry and market overviews
  • Advising internal and external clients, corporates and management teams

Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills

  • Exceptional writing skills

  • Ability to multi-task and collaborate within a team environment

  • Confidence and initiative to take on responsibility and manage your own projects
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • We're a global company whose primary business language is English and so fluency in English is required.

Job Summary

We're looking for a Business Development Executive to drive business growth within our Affluent Banking business. You’ll play a key role in acquiring new clients, strengthening relationships, and delivering personal financial advice. Your day-to-day will involve planning strategies to meet sales targets, sharing market insights, and supporting promotional activities such as campaigns and seminars. You’ll also ensure smooth after-sales service and identify opportunities to cross-sell relevant products.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, client-focused environment and is passionate about helping people achieve their financial goals.

About Our Wealth And Retail Banking Business

Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) serves more than 13 million individuals and small businesses, with a focus on the affluent segment including Private Banking, Priority Private, Priority Banking, and Premium. In the mass retail space, we're focused on emerging affluent clients who will progress in their wealth journey with us and form the pipeline of future affluent clients.

We’re a leading wealth manager in Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Our local presence and international network enable us to capture the strong structural tailwinds which are driving cross-border wealth flows. Our comprehensive product offerings span across deposits, payments, financing, advisory, investments and bancassurance.

We’re investing USD $1.5 billion in our Affluent banking business. Our investment focuses on affluent frontline teams, wealth and digital platforms, and client centres, as well as brand and marketing, to drive growth. You’ll join a growing franchise within the Standard Chartered Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source and engage individual prospects to acquire new business.
  • Conduct professional, consultative financial analysis sessions with customers.
  • Identify and articulate customers’ specific financial needs and objectives, offering targeted solutions.
  • Foster and deepen client relationships by providing regular market updates and financial product trend analysis (both local and international).
  • Participate in marketing and promotional activities aimed at successful customer acquisition.

Skills And Experience

  • Strong competencies in client acquisition and sophisticated account management, particularly with High Net Worth (HNW) individuals.
  • Expertise in region-specific languages and established local networks (highly valued).
  • Technical knowledge of consumer banking products (Treasury, Equities, Funds, and Insurance).
  • A university degree is preferred.
  • Relevant experience in customer service or sales is an advantage; however, applications from fresh graduates who possess the required skills and qualifications will also be considered.

Qualifications

  • Essential professional qualifications: HKSI Paper 1, 7, 8 and IIQE Paper 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do

Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.

Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits

Job Summary

Develop and implement communications strategy and programs to continuously protect and promote the Bank's brand and bring to life the Bank's business strategy and core values via multiple external/internal touchpoints.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Play a pivot role in developing and implementing communications strategy consistent with the Bank’s business strategies and priorities in China
  • Continuously build profile and uplift visibility for the bank in areas relating to Corporate & Investment Banking, Branding initiatives and Corporate Social Responsibilities

Business

  • Sound knowledge of the Bank’s global franchise, China market and a good understanding of the opportunities opening up for CIB business
  • Develop and implement strategic communications plan and roadmap, focusing on the Bank's strategy and business priorities
  • Focus on the following areas of CIB business from strategy to communications programmes & execution:
  • Coverage – Corporates & Financial Institutions
  • CIB Products – TB & FM
  • Initiatives such as China Opening-up, Chinese Enterprises Going Global, RMB Internationalisation, Belt & Road, Financial Connectivity Schemes, Sustainable and Transition Finance, Digitalisation
  • Executive profiling for senior executives' thought leadership in line with respective business focuses
  • Develop press releases, executive speeches, Op-Ed, WeChat articles and LinkedIn posts for corporate and business communications related programs
  • Arrange media interviews on proactive basis for major business developments/milestones and the Bank's focus areas
  • Lead media relations for China East region and provide communications support for reputational risk management for incidents in East

Risk Management

  • Adherence to laws and regulations, internal risk and compliance policies (including anti-money laundering, sanction, anti-bribery & corruption and relevant FCC risks) and the Group Code of Conduct
  • Work closely with media monitoring agency to be aware of related media voice on potential issues and provide sound judgement and mitigation plan from communications perspective
  • Play a key role in reputational risk management for the Bank, and work as a key CABM contact window for China East Region

Governance

  • Ensure adherence to the Risk Management Framework, Group Code of Conduct and various Policies, Procedures and Guidelines of the Bank by the Group and China CABM teams
  • Play a pivotal role in guiding relevant stakeholders on communications-related guidelines and best practices
  • Maintain high awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the business operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role
  • Completion of all mandatory training needed including e-learning within stated timeframes to support the understanding of the roles for delivering effective governance

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

Internal

  • China EXCO members
  • CIB China Head Office & CIB Business
  • East CGMs
  • China & Group CABM

External

  • Media
  • Communications counterparts at regulatory/ governmental authorities
  • Key financial analysts & opinion leaders
  • General public

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in CABM
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures;
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

Skills And Experience

  • Communications Strategy & Planning
  • Copywriting & Content Development
  • Media Engagement & Management
  • Reputational Risk Management
  • Strategic & Creative Thinking

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of communications experience, preferably with experience related to the financial services industry
  • Proven communications expertise, with the ability to develop and execute integrated communications strategies across earned, owned, and paid media channels
  • Strong writing, editing, and content development skills in both Chinese and English
  • Sound judgment and experience in issues and reputational risk management
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across businesses and functions
  • Strong self-motivation, strategic thinking, adaptability, and a high-level attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Word and Outlook); familiarity with digital communications platforms, social media analytics and AI-enabled productivity tools is an advantage

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

About Us

Middle Office Account Services Team (also known as Transitions Team) is a Global Middle Office Team, which oversee and track Client’s events such as Account Launches, Account Terminations, Custody Changes, Custody Conversion, etc. with other internal State Street Teams. In addition, Account Services provides a centralized First Point of Contact (FPOC/primary contact) between the Client (and other interest parties) and internal State Street teams.

Purpose of Role

The position will support and maintain the Middle Office production processing of multiple client’s portfolio static data, and the coordination of Transition events such as New Account Setups, Account Restructures, Terminations, Account Maintenance and other changes.

The position requires regular independent interaction with internal teams, client contacts, custodians and other interest parties. The data elements gathered need to be maintained in an accurate and timely manner to help support the clients’ trading activities in addition to supporting numerous departments within the organization. The position will also be the primary point of contact internally and externally regarding the data elements, hence excellent interpersonal, communication and organizational skills are a must for the role.

Responsibilities And Duties

Complete the day-to-day responsibilities of the team within a strong risk and control environment that minimizes incidents and errors. Own the research and resolution of issues involving all operational and various IT areas (e.g. Asset Servicing, Trade Operations, Account Transitions, COACS). Conduct high-level analysis in specific areas of expertise, identify and resolve work-processing issues and make suggestions to streamline operations. Coordinate with Account Service management team to approve documented workflow, procedures and controls, determining impact of activity to other areas. Make proactive recommendations and solutions for problems resolution. Interface with senior level, internal and external stakeholders and other departments on complex matters and inquiries.

Liaise with colleagues within the Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, USA, UK and India State Street offices and divisions globally where required for query resolution. Support and provide analysis for Client Change Request items impacting the Enterprise processes and Operating Models.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Broad and in-depth understanding of the asset management industry, gained through working with an asset manager, portfolio manager or custodian
  • Broad and in-depth understanding of standards, methodologies, processes, systems and technology necessary to support investment management operations
  • Experience with writing and reviewing business specifications, procedures, operating models, etc.
  • Excellent analytical skills and ability to analyze quickly
  • Strong written and communication skills to people at all levels
  • Must be self-motivated, adaptable and show initiative in different circumstances and under pressure
  • Ability to work well in a team
  • Flexibility in working outside of your responsibilities and areas of expertise
  • Flexible working hours may be required
  • Bachelor’s degree with emphasis in finance, accounting, or technology or equivalent work experience in finance or accounting


About State Street

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Middle Office Account Services Team (also known as Transitions Team) is a Global Middle Office Team, which oversee and track Client’s events such as Account Launches, Account Terminations, Custody Changes, Custody Conversion, etc. with other internal State Street Teams. In addition, Account Services provides a centralized First Point of Contact (FPOC/primary contact) between the Client (and other interest parties) and internal State Street teams.
Purpose of Role
The position will support and maintain the Middle Office production processing of multiple client’s portfolio static data, and the coordination of Transition events such as New Account Setups, Account Restructures, Terminations, Account Maintenance and other changes.
The position requires regular independent interaction with internal teams, client contacts, custodians and other interest parties. The data elements gathered need to be maintained in an accurate and timely manner to help support the clients’ trading activities in addition to supporting numerous departments within the organization. The position will also be the primary point of contact internally and externally regarding the data elements, hence excellent interpersonal, communication and organizational skills are a must for the role.
Responsibilities And Duties
Complete the day-to-day responsibilities of the team within a strong risk and control environment that minimizes incidents and errors. Own the research and resolution of issues involving all operational and various IT areas (e.g. Asset Servicing, Trade Operations, Account Transitions, COACS). Conduct high-level analysis in specific areas of expertise, identify and resolve work-processing issues and make suggestions to streamline operations. Coordinate with Account Service management team to approve documented workflow, procedures and controls, determining impact of activity to other areas. Make proactive recommendations and solutions for problems resolution. Interface with senior level, internal and external stakeholders and other departments on complex matters and inquiries.
Liaise with colleagues within the Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, USA, UK and India State Street offices and divisions globally where required for query resolution. Support and provide analysis for Client Change Request items impacting the Enterprise processes and Operating Models.
Required Experience & Skills
Broad and in-depth understanding of the asset management industry, gained through working with an asset manager, portfolio manager or custodian
Broad and in-depth understanding of standards, methodologies, processes, systems and technology necessary to support investment management operations
Experience with writing and reviewing business specifications, procedures, operating models, etc.
Excellent analytical skills and ability to analyze quickly
Strong written and communication skills to people at all levels
Must be self-motivated, adaptable and show initiative in different circumstances and under pressure
Ability to work well in a team
Flexibility in working outside of your responsibilities and areas of expertise
Flexible working hours may be required
Bachelor’s degree with emphasis in finance, accounting, or technology or equivalent work experience in finance or accounting

Who We Are Looking For

The Officer is responsible for overseeing several teams and ensuring team compliance with operating policies, procedures and guidelines in the timely completion of accurate Fund administration. They are also responsible for team development and staff management, including the interview and hiring process and also performance review and assessment. . In addition the Officer will also be involved with and drive projects such as the provision of management reporting, BCP and Risk initiatives, as well as ad hoc project work with the objectives of enhancing client satisfaction or wining operational efficiencies.

Why This Role Is Important To Us

The team you will be joining is a part of International Fund Services (IFS), acquired by State Street in July 2002. IFS, also known as Alternative Investment Solutions is a recognized industry-leading provider of fund accounting, fund administration and risk services to hedge funds and private equity funds. These services are fully integrated to provide complete end-to-end solutions that span the front-, middle- and back-office requirements of institutional investors.

Join us if making your mark in the alternative investment industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As Fund Accounting, Officer you will

  • Plans, schedules, and manages the daily workflow of one or more client relationships;
  • Professionally review 6 processes, including bookkeeping, capital call/ distribution package (schedule/ notices/ driver report), financial statements (balance sheet/ income statement/ schedule of investment and other required financial statements), bank reconciliation, partners’ capital account statements, client reports (audit confirmation, deal slip, LP reports, cash ledger, LP register, etc.)
  • Facilitates the successful start-up of new funds and conversion of new clients. Ensures thorough, proper planning;
  • Monitoring team daily operations, be able to aware of potential risks and make improvement of the process; professionally organize 1:1 meeting with team members; work closely with manager and timely provide feedbacks and valuable suggestions; confidently and efficiently communicate with home site, maintain good relationship with home site;
  • Be able to professionally resolve issues and provide help to colleagues, maintain the healthy relationship within the team;
  • Monitor the deliverables, ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of deliverables; be able to flexibly arrange work among the team;
  • Ensures all controls and procedures are adhered to as well as makes recommendations for changes;
  • Ensures all personnel are appropriately selected, thoroughly trained and given timely and complete performance evaluation feedback;
  • Develop internal training classes with the training liaison;
  • Maintains positive relationships with home site;
  • Build a collaborative relationship with inter-departmental contacts and achieve business goals;
  • Other special projects or tasks assigned;


What We Value

This role requires strong communication, staff management and client serving skills as well relevant industry experience.

Candidates must have a college degree (business, accounting, economics, mathematics, finance and at least 5 years of accounting and/or financial service operations experience.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

  • Accounting background is preferred;
  • Familiar with PE/RE funds and market;
  • 5+ years’ experience in Fund Accounting; big four/ fund house / accounting firm work experience is preferred;
  • CPA/ ACCA a plus (at least in processing);
  • Candidates with long periods at the same companies;
  • Strong English and communication skills;
  • Strong problem solving and analytical skills;
  • Detail-oriented, owner’s mindset, logical thinking, strong learning ability, sense of responsibility and team work are required;
  • Good interpersonal skill and team spirit; effective communication, organizational and negotiation skills;
